product.title: Grand Canyon Signature Hummer Tour with Optional Sunset Views

description.text: Ride an open-air Hummer along restricted South Rim roads to viewpoints most visitors never reach. A driver-guide shares canyon history at each stop, with an optional sunset departure timed for golden light over the inner gorge.

highlights: Open-air Hummer tour on restricted South Rim routes
Multiple rim viewpoints with photo time at each stop
Optional sunset departure for golden-hour canyon light
Driver-guide commentary on geology and park history

start.description: Meet at the Hummer tour check-in desk in Tusayan, AZ 86023, or at the National Geographic Visitor Center.

end.description: Return to the Tusayan check-in point after the final rim viewpoint stop.

product.itinerarySummary: Ride an open-air Hummer along restricted South Rim roads to viewpoints most visitors never reach.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon National Park
itineraryItems.description: Two-and-a-half-hour Hummer loop covering multiple South Rim overlooks and restricted roads.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Grand Canyon Signature Hummer Tour with Optional Sunset Views?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at the Grand Canyon?
faqs.answer: Meet at the Hummer tour check-in desk in Tusayan, AZ 86023, or at the National Geographic Visitor Center.
